status: Kept: canonical aggregate argument transport for synchronous Effect runners.

change.transport: Preserve logical NativeValue/NativePlace arguments until the call boundary. Pass canonical aggregate addresses to synchronous Effect runners and copy bytes into callee-owned storage on entry.
change.captures: Project the stored capture-time environment, not original capture source locals. Borrowed/stored carrier environments still materialize their actual boundary representation.
change.unchanged: Result transport, machine/C ABI, ordinary scalar transport, suspension frames and persistent continuation payloads.
change.temporaries: Fixed-size argument repacking storage is placed in the LLVM entry block, not dynamically allocated on each loop iteration.
change.threshold: Semantic Place classification; no benchmark-specific size threshold.

methodology.samples: Six fresh processes per batch, ordered before/after/after/before/before/after.
methodology.baseline: Snapshot already includes the preceding transient-outcome optimization. The final batch uses the final LLVM library in both modes; its entry-allocation option is opt-in.
methodology.caches: Node compilation cache and persistent native cache disabled. Shared host; OS page cache was not flushed.
methodology.isolation: No task tests or other builds overlap either included timing batch. Instruction-attribution builds are separate.
methodology.checks: Source/dist fingerprint agrees before and after each batch. Every AST matches the 40,780-byte reference. Final control binaries match the original baseline, and final candidate binaries match the instruction-attribution binary.
methodology.excludedAttempt:
The first paired batch was stopped during its first control compilation because the separately
launched parser AST oracle briefly overlapped its start. No timing sample from that attempt is
included. The oracle completed successfully with byte-identical AST output; the six-sample batch
was then restarted in isolation. The partial attempt was stopped with SIGTERM against the exact
three task process IDs (harness, time wrapper, compiler).
methodology.initialBatchCaveat: Initial runnable implementation, before fixed temporaries were placed in entry and the zero-capture path was simplified; not pooled with final measurements.

finalBatch.control: Read-only loader substitutes initial compiler dist, which already includes the preceding transient-outcome optimization. Both modes use the final LLVM implementation (entry placement is opt-in); the after compiler transports canonical aggregate arguments to synchronous Effect runners and copies them into callee-owned storage. Every control binary is checked against the original baseline.
